instructions: One short email, plain text, no link. Open with the specific reason this company is being contacted right now - the signal that put them on the list (a job post, a competitor's post they engaged with). Then the offer in one line: send us your list, you get it back with verified emails and direct dials, priced per record, you only pay for records we fill. Ask for a reply, not a click: 'want me to run a sample of 100 for free?'. Never pitch the subscription.
followup_instructions: Two sentences maximum. Add one new fact each time - a number, a comparable customer, a fill rate - never repeat the pitch and never write 'just following up'. Last email in the sequence asks for a yes or a no, and means it.
